Name: Huggable Scarecrows
Author: bogie5464
Description:
Tired of walking over to pet your animals every morning? Then this mod is for you! Just place any scarecrow (even rarecrows) into your coop/barn, and let the brainless scarecrow do it for you! Makes scarecrows pet all animals every morning.

Github: [url=https://github.com/bogie5464/HuggableScarecrows]https://github.com/bogie5464/HuggableScarecrows[/url]
